More info Thank you for subscribing Boots shoppers are racing to buy a Korean and Japanese skincare box which boasts savings of more than £105 ahead of the Christmas shopping period. Boots K+J Beauty Skin Edit has been flying off shelves since its release, and it shows no signs of slowing down as we head towards the festive season.
 The trending Boots box is priced at £35 , and is packed with nine bestselling products which would cost you more than £140 if you were to buy them individually. The Boots K+J Beauty Skin Edit contains six full sizes and three travel sizes, with everything from firming collagen masks, to rejuvenating cream, a sun stick, toner pads, and more.
 Just some of the viral names you will find inside are Beauty Of Joseon and Biodance, along with some lesser known brands like Dr. Reju and Purito. Shoppers can view the full content list below or over on the Boots website.

 READ MORE: John Lewis £72 Christmas bauble with MAC and NARS makeup plummets to £24 in savvy deal 
 Box contains: 
 Beauty Of Joseon Matte Sun Stick, Mugwort + Camilia, 18G - Full Size
 Dr.Reju-All Advanced Pdrn Rejuvenating Cream, 20ML - Full Size
 Dr Jart Hydro Firming Mask With Hydrolysed Collagen, 30G - Full Size
 Haru Haru Wonder Black Rice Bakuchiol Eye Cream, 20ML - Full Size
 Laka Fruity Glam Tint – Shade Salty, 1.6G - Full Size
 Curel Deep Moisture Spray, 60G - Full Size
 Biodance Collagen Gel Toner Pads, 10PK
 Purito Oat-In Calming Gel Cream, 100ML
 Genabelle Pdrn Vita Toning Ampoule, 30ML
 The £35 box allows shoppers to save over £105 (Image: Boots) 
 The box has gained almost nothing but five star reviews on the Boots website so far, with one shopper writing: "This is my first time trying a Boots box and I am so pleased! The value for money is great with so many full size products, and these skin care products are a dream. My face is glowing and feels so soft. K & J skincare is definitely the future!"
 A second said: "I found this by accident, and I'm so glad I did. It has a fab range of K-Beauty skincare, and a bit of makeup, in it...! The products are nearly all full size, and the box is exceptional value for money. It has several things in it that I am using already, and others that are (or rather were) on my radar to try out. For anyone sitting on the fence, give it a go!"
 A third wrote: "Excellent value for money. Almost all of the items are full size and amazing selection. My friends have bought this as well and are so happy. I use the reju-all and is quite expensive on its own so I’m grateful to spend £35 on items that are useful for me."

 Less impressed, somebody gave it three stars, writing: "Love the box but the lip product is not as advertised. The rest of the products are great. Same as another review as told to send back however had started using other products before I realised lip shade was wrong." 
 The Korean beauty movement has taken the western market by storm, with thousands of shoppers ditching their usual routines in favour of their natural ingredients and incredibly anti-ageing results, reports the Echo .
 Show more 
 For an even grander Christmas gifting option, Boots also has the StyleKorean 24 Days K-Beauty Advent Calendar. It contains products with a combined total of £302.31, but costs £89.90 - a saving of £212.41. 
 If you're looking for a new routine, the LookFantastic X Beauty of Joseon Rice & Shine Set is also worth considering. Costing £39 with a complimentary gift included, the three step system includes a full sized toner, serum, and SPF 50, along with a complimentary compact mirror.
 Or at Space NK, there's the The Ultimate Skincare Must-Haves box. Costing £65, the products inside are worth a whopping £295, making for a pretty saving.
